videos.overview: As the Alola Pokémon League nears the finals, the stakes are getting higher, and temperatures are rising to a fever pitch!

videos.title: The Wisdom Not to Run!
videos.overview: The second round of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals is proceeding at a rapid pace, and there's a lot more going on than meets the eye!

videos.title: Final Rivals!
videos.overview: It's time for the Alola Pokémon League finals, and the competitors are more determined than ever to become Champion!

videos.title: Enter the Champion!
videos.overview: The Alola Pokémon League is down to the final moments of the final battle! Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: Z-Move Showdown!
videos.overview: Although the Alola Pokémon League is over, a new type of excitement is just beginning!

videos.title: Exhibition Unmasked!
videos.overview: The Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match is off to a fiery start-just as expected for a battle between Ash and the now-unmasked Masked Royal!

videos.title: A Full Battle Bounty!
videos.overview: In the air or on the ground, the Alola Pokémon League's exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui is roaring along!

videos.title: Fiery Surprises!
videos.overview: The exhibition match between Ash and Professor Kukui continues with a long-awaited fiery showdown!

videos.title: From Z to Shining Z!
videos.overview: Ash's win at the Alola Pokémon League was astounding-but the resulting exhibition match has some colossal surprises in store, too!

videos.title: Dreaming of the Sun and Moon!
videos.overview: Now that the Alola Pokémon League is over, it's time for the Pokémon School class to make plans for their upcoming vacation!

videos.title: Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!
videos.overview: With their big vacation on the horizon, our heroes are setting some life-changing plans into motion!

videos.title: Enter Pikachu!
videos.overview: Though he's excited to attend Professor Oak's Pokémon camp, Ash oversleeps when the day arrives. Newcomer Goh is just as excited — and on time.

videos.title: Legend? Go! Friends? Go!
videos.overview: Professor Oak invites Ash to the opening ceremony for Professor Cerise's new lab in Vermilion City. Goh sets out to catch a legendary Pokémon.

videos.title: Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!
videos.overview: Professor Cerise asks Ash and Goh to investigate the sudden appearance of Ivysaur in Vermilion City, but the two researchers disagree on their methods.

videos.title: Settling the Scorebunny!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh head to the Galar region on assignment. During their stopover, some Pokémon steal Ash's backpack — with Ash and Goh's train tickets inside!

videos.title: Mind-Boggling Dynamax!
videos.overview: Once they get off the train, Ash and Goh set out on the hunt for Dynamax Pokémon. Meanwhile, a Scorbunny is hot on their trail.

videos.title: Working My Way Back to Mew!
videos.overview: After learning more about the Pokédex functions on their Rotom Phones from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh head out to catch some local Pokémon.

videos.title: Serving Up the Flute Cup!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh travel to the Hoenn region, where Ash has entered Goh into the Battle Frontier Flute Cup. Their first opponents are Hodge and his Hariyama.

videos.title: The Sinnoh Iceberg Race!
videos.overview: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

videos.title: Finding a Legend!
videos.overview: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

videos.title: A Test in Paradise!
videos.overview: After a ship's captain reports being saved by a Dragonite, Goh and Ash set out in search of the Dragonite island that they believe exists ... somewhere.

videos.title: Best Friend... Worst Nightmare!
videos.overview: While the laboratory staff deal with a mysterious power outage, Chloe contemplates her future and her relationship with Pokémon.

videos.title: Flash of the Titans!
videos.overview: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to the World Coronation Series finals in the Galar region, where the strongest trainers battle for glory!

videos.title: The Climb to Be the Very Best!
videos.overview: When a Gigantamax Drednaw interrupts the World Coronation finals in pursuit of Team Rocket, Ash, Goh and their Pokémon spring into action!

videos.title: Raid Battle in the Ruins!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh travel to the Unova region, where they head to the newly discovered Ruins of the Titan site at Desert Resort to search for Pokémon.

videos.title: A Snow Day for Searching!
videos.overview: After snow in Vermilion City forces Professor Cerise to shut down the lab for system maintenance, Goh heads home for a few days to visit his family.

videos.title: A Chilling Curse!
videos.overview: Gengar's hauntings at the lab resume. Ash and Goh vow to capture the poltergeist Pokémon, and Professor Cerise explains the lab's paranormal history.

videos.title: Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!
videos.overview: After Darmanitan taunts Scorbunny in a practice battle, Scorbunny is determined to learn the Ember attack, but getting Goh's attention is a challenge.

videos.title: Destination: Coronation!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh head to the Vermilion Gym, where Ash challenges the substitute Gym Leader as his first World Coronation Series opponent.

videos.title: A Talent for Imitation!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash visit a film set, where the star, a Ditto, flees after a fight with the director. They search for her, but she's fallen in with Team Rocket!

videos.title: Dreams Are Made of These!
videos.overview: Pokémon Orienteering day dawns bright and early, with Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise each leading a group of kids on a trek through Vermilion City.

videos.title: Caring for a Mystery!
videos.overview: After learning about Pokémon Eggs, Goh wants to find one. Ash's latest World Coronation Series match ends with him feeling like someone is calling him.

videos.title: Goodbye, Friend!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh head to the Hoenn region to witness the annual migration of Beautifly, but first they have to find them. Goh's Raboot starts acting out.

videos.title: Panic in the Park!
videos.overview: Someone seems to be stealing the food that the researchers leave out for Pokémon in Cerise Park. To catch the culprit, Ash and Goh camp out.

videos.title: A Little Rocket R & R!
videos.overview: Team Rocket are sent to the Sinnoh region for a vacation, but their break is interrupted by the arrival of Ash and Goh looking for a special Pokémon.

videos.title: A Festival Reunion!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh head to the Kalos region, where Goh wants to catch Kalos Pokémon and Ash sets his sights on a World Coronation Series Battle Festival.

videos.title: Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown! / Slowking's Crowning!
videos.overview: Goh enters his giant Magikarp in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Tournament. Then he and Ash head to Slowpoke Island, hoping to catch a Slowpoke.

videos.title: Toughing It Out!
videos.overview: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to a World Coronation Series Master Class battle in Galar, with challenger Raihan battling champion Leon.

videos.title: Sobbing Sobble!
videos.overview: A Sobble sneaks up on Ash and Goh while they're eating at the Wyndon Pokémon Center. To catch it, they have to follow a trail of crying people.

videos.title: There's a New Kid in Town!
videos.overview: Yamper brings home an injured Pidove, so Professor Cerise and his family decide to nurse it back to health. Chloe has her hands full keeping the peace!

videos.title: Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!
videos.overview: Ash and Riolu are on a roll after the latest World Coronation Series battle, and Pikachu is jealous! When Ash's mom visits, Pikachu follows her home.

videos.title: The Cuteness Quotient!
videos.overview: Chloe asks Ash and Goh to step in at her younger brother Parker's school: His friend Nami is upset that other kids say her Feebas isn't cute.

videos.title: Time After Time!
videos.overview: Goh joins his parents for a family vacation in the Johto region. Walking through the woods, he recalls meeting another trainer there three years ago.

videos.title: Trade, Borrow, and Steal!
videos.overview: The local Pokémon Center is hosting a Pokémon trading event. When Ash and Goh head over to check it out, they meet a trainer who's a Bug-type enthusiast.

videos.title: Solitary and Menacing!
videos.overview: Ash travels to Saffron City to battle his next opponent, but when he learns that the Karate Master has been defeated, he challenges the victor instead.

videos.title: Gotta Catch a What?!
videos.overview: Goh decides to catch a Pikachu, and Professor Cerise informs him about a mass outbreak of Pikachu in the mountains. But Team Rocket is on the hunt too!

videos.title: Making Battles in the Sand!
videos.overview: After Ash battles new opponents in the World Coronation Series, the Cerise Laboratory researchers head to the Hoenn region to investigate a sandstorm.

videos.title: That New Old Gang of Mine!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh head to the Alola region and reunite with Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet and Ash's human and Pokémon friends at the Pokémon School.

videos.title: Restore and Renew!
videos.overview: With Chloe in tow, Ash and Goh visit the Pewter Museum of Science. Goh heads to a public dig site to find a Fossil Pokémon, but Team Rocket is there!

videos.title: Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash travel to the Cianwood Gym in the Johto region so Ash can take on Bea in a World Coronation Series rematch.

videos.title: A Crackling Raid Battle!
videos.overview: When a hot day in Vermilion City turns thunderous, Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise suspect that the Legendary bird Pokémon Zapdos is somewhere nearby.

videos.title: Pikachu Translation Check! / Up to Your Neck!
videos.overview: While Meowth battles a cold, Jessie and James review a video of Ash's Pikachu. On a forest walk, Ash and Goh try to help a wild Marshtomp.

videos.title: Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh set out for the Galar region to investigate the Dynamax phenomenon. During a train delay, they meet strange Pokémon in a mysterious forest.

videos.title: Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!
videos.overview: While Goh and Sonia investigate the Darkest Day in Turffield, Team Rocket infiltrates the Galar Energy Plant, with Ash and Leon heading there too.

videos.title: Sword and Shield: From Here to Eternatus!
videos.overview: Ash heads to Stow-on-Side to meet Sonia and Goh, who conclude that the Darkest Day is a Pokémon. At the Energy Plant, Leon encounters it directly.

videos.title: Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!
videos.overview: At the stadium, Leon and Team Rocket are no match for Eternatus. Ash takes on Chairman Rose while Goh battles Oleana to break through and end the chaos.

videos.title: Getting More Than You Battled For!
videos.overview: When Psychic energy is detected on Cero Island, Ash and Goh head out in hopes of finding Mew. When they get there, they meet an old foe: Mewtwo!

videos.title: Crowning the Chow Crusher!
videos.overview: The Vermilion City Pokémon Eating Contest is on, and Ash, Goh and their Pokémon are competing for a trip to Unova. Team Rocket wants to win too.

videos.title: A Close Call... Practically!
videos.overview: Setting out on Goh's prize trip, Ash and Goh arrive in Castelia City. Unbeknownst to them, Team Rocket is lying in wait to kidnap Pikachu!

videos.title: To Train, or Not to Train!
videos.overview: A mysterious Eevee runs away from the Eevee Evolution Laboratory and meets Chloe. Meanwhile, Team Rocket makes a plan to steal some students' Pokémon.

videos.title: A Pinch of This, A Pinch of That!
videos.overview: Ash, Goh and Chloe head to the Galar region to investigate some of its unusual fossils. The on-site researchers want to reconstruct the ancient Pokémon.

videos.title: Trials of a Budding Master!
videos.overview: Investigating an outbreak of Geodude in Rock Tunnel, Ash and Goh meet a trainer who accepts Ash's challenge to a World Coronation battle with Gurdurr!

videos.title: How Are Ya Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm?
videos.overview: When Professor Cerise's former student asks for help with some Diglett and Dugtrio wreaking havoc on his farm, Goh, Ash and Chloe go check it out.

videos.title: Healing the Healer!
videos.overview: Hearing rumors that the legendary Suicune has been spotted at a lake, Ash and Goh travel to the Johto region, where they find a human polluting plot.

videos.title: Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash visit the set of a popular spy movie. When the film's Inteleon star cinematically foils a Team Rocket attack, Goh's Sobble is inspired.

videos.title: The Tale of You and Glimwood Tangle!
videos.overview: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Glimwood Tangle to learn more about Galarian Ponyta and Rapidash. Separated in the forest, they have storybook adventures.

videos.title: Searching for Chivalry!
videos.overview: After hearing about Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four, Ash and Goh travel to his castle to take his test alongside their Farfetch'd and Scyther.

videos.title: Memories of a Warming Kindness
videos.overview: While Ash and Goh take advantage of a cold snap to search for Ice Pokémon, Chloe enjoys some girls' time with lab assistant Chrysa at her apartment.

videos.title: A Rollicking Roll…Eyes on the Goal!
videos.overview: When Team Rocket's Pelipper dispenses too many Gulpin from the Prize Master, trouble rolls through Vermilion City. Then, the race is on with Chewtle!

videos.title: When a House Is Not a Home!
videos.overview: Goh finds a Grookey in the lab and tries to capture it, only to learn it belongs to someone else. To locate its owner, he and Ash set out on a search.

videos.title: Beyond Chivalry…Aiming to Be a Leek Master!
videos.overview: Ash runs into Rinto, who's also in the World Coronation Series, at the Pokémon Center. He and Farfetch'd challenge Rinto and Gallade to a rematch!

videos.title: Searching for Service with a Smile!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash offer to help handyperson Multa after her partner is injured. Out on the job, they cross paths with Team Rocket and their latest plot.

videos.title: Not Too Close for Comfort!
videos.overview: Goh's Sobble evolves into a Drizzile. But for some reason, it withdraws to a cave in Cerise Park, much to Goh's consternation.

videos.title: On Land, in the Sea, and to the Future!
videos.overview: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Hoenn to meet race champion trainer Kiley and his Vaporeon. At his suggestion, they enter the Kids Marine Athletic Race.

videos.title: Absol Absolved
videos.overview: Goh and Ash travel to Lavaridge Town to help their old friend Hodge, whose uncle's hot springs have gone dry — perhaps due to an Absol spotted nearby.

videos.title: Thrash of the Titans!
videos.overview: Ash receives a letter from an old friend in Unova: Iris! He and Goh head to Opelucid City so Ash can face her in a World Coronation Series battle.

videos.title: Under Color of Darkness!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash travel to Kalos to find a new flower for one of Goh's Flabébé. After a few days, they visit a plant researcher for some expert insights.

videos.title: Sleuths for Truth!
videos.overview: Officer Jenny and an Inspector Decker visit the lab, searching for the culprit in a series of electricity thefts. Decker decides Pikachu is responsible!

videos.title: Advice to Goh!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh travel to Pallet to visit Professor Oak, who offers Goh a job on the Project Mew research team. They also run into Ash's old frenemy, Gary.

videos.title: Errand Endurance!
videos.overview: Goh and Chloe dispatch their Grookey and Eevee on an errand together but secretly follow them to supervise. Team Rocket do the same with Pelipper.

videos.title: Take My Thief! Please!
videos.overview: After trying and failing to get rid of their Morpeko, Team Rocket hatch a plan to get Goh to capture it so they don't have to feed it anymore.

videos.title: Leaping Toward the Dream!
videos.overview: Goh travels to the Sinnoh region for his first mission with Project Mew, accompanied by Ash. It turns out, becoming a full team member is quite a trial!

videos.title: Everybody's Doing the Underground Shuffle!
videos.overview: Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to Driftveil City after hearing about a Klink. Surprised in a cave by Team Rocket, the two groups' members get mixed up!

videos.title: Grabbing the Brass Ring!
videos.overview: After learning about Falinks from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh go to Galar to see one. Meanwhile, an Eiscue adrift on an ice floe washes up in Galar.

videos.title: Nightfall? Nightmares!
videos.overview: Goh and Ash head to Sinnoh after reports of nightmares, suspecting the mythical Pokémon Darkrai is responsible. Chloe and Eevee travel to Sinnoh too.

videos.title: A Midsummer Night's Light!
videos.overview: Dawn and Chloe find an injured Cresselia and are able to give it first aid. Ash and Goh are still on Darkrai's trail, and so is Team Rocket.

videos.title: All Out, All of the Time!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh race through the mountains on a deserted island in the Alola region — where they meet the lively All-Out brothers, Phil and Mayshure.

videos.title: Excitement from the Ultra-Shocking Start!
videos.overview: Ash has leveled up to the Ultra Class! Now, he must face gym leader Volkner in a blazing battle in solar-powered Sunyshore City.

videos.title: Detective Drizzile!
videos.overview: Something has caused the Cerise Lab's data to suddenly vanish. Drizzile helps the team track down the mysterious culprit.

videos.title: Night and Day, You Are the Ones!
videos.overview: Adam, Goh and Chloe arrive at Eclipse Castle to meet Espeon and Umbreon and see their special Pokémon powers firsthand.

videos.title: Trial on a Golden Scale!
videos.overview: In search of Volcarona, the Sun Pokémon, Ash and Goh head to the Colossus Ruins in the Unova region for Goh's first trial mission from Project Mew.

videos.title: Mad About Blue!
videos.overview: The crew spies the rare and spherical Voltorb and bumps into Gorman, a blue Pokémon fanatic. But Team Rocket plots to ruin the fun with this new friend.

videos.title: The Sweet Taste of Battle!
videos.overview: The tasty Alcremie, a Pokémon made of cream, floats toward Goh and pals. Later, gym leader Opal arranges a special challenge with Leon.

videos.title: Star Night, Star Flight!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh run into champion Cynthia while investigating strange phenomena in the Johto region, where daytime has plunged into total darkness.

videos.title: An Adventure of Mega Proportions!
videos.overview: Ash receives a mega glove from cheerleader Korrina in Shalour City. Later, the gang searches for a mega stone to help Lucario mega evolve.

videos.title: Battle Three with Bea!
videos.overview: Ash and Bea have already faced off twice. Will Ash have better luck during their third showdown at Stow-on-Side Stadium with Korrina in the stands?

videos.title: A Battle of Mega Versus Max!
videos.overview: With a contentious back-and-forth battle with Bea, Ash brings out Sirfetch'd, Pikachu and Lucario to bolster his attacks and defensive strength.

videos.title: Breaking the Ice!
videos.overview: Goh brings Ash along to school for a presentation. Later, transfer student Regina and her Glaceon Pokémon cause a freeze over the entire class.

videos.title: Looking Out for Number Two!
videos.overview: Ash and Goh dive into the deep waters of the Hoenn region for Goh's trial mission. This time, he's off to catch a wild Kingdra, a Dragon Pokémon.

videos.title: The Gates of Warp! (1)
videos.overview: Team Rocket shows up while Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to the Sinnoh region to investigate multiple missing Pokémon reports — including Dawn's Piplup.

videos.title: Showdown at the Gates of Warp! (2)
videos.overview: Time's running out and flowing backwards as Ash, Goh and friends enter a strange world and battle alongside different versions of themselves.

videos.title: The Spectral Express!
videos.overview: On their way to catch a ride to Stow-on-Side, Ash and Goh take a wild trip aboard a mysterious and eerie ghost train.

videos.title: The Winding Path to Greatness!
videos.overview: Hoping to get his Pokémon Gengar to Gigantamax, Ash and Goh look for help from the Ghost-type gym leader, Allister.

videos.title: It's All in the Name!
videos.overview: After unusual magnetic waves affect his Magnemite, Francois, Ren works together with Ash, Goh, Chrysa and Professor Cerise to solve the mystery.

videos.title: Suffering the Flings and Arrows!
videos.overview: When Lilligant draws the romantic interest of its beloved Heracross, Pinsir is devastated. Could a Pokémon flower arrangement class save the day?

videos.title: The Good, the Bad and the Lucky!
videos.overview: Tired of their missions always coming up short, Team Rocket decides to follow Pelipper to find out who's in charge of the Prize Master.

videos.title: Lighting the Way Home!
videos.overview: The Space Center plans to use Ampharos' light to guide a satellite back home. But after Ampharos loses confidence, it's up to Sophocles to save the day.

videos.title: An Evolution in Taste!
videos.overview: Hoping to add to his collection, Goh brings Ash along with him to Slowpoke Island. After meeting different Slowpokes, they try the local cuisine.

videos.title: Out of Their Elements!
videos.overview: Ash, Goh and Chloe visit a Pokémon Circus, where the closing performers run into a problem after the evolutions of their Eevees don't go as planned.

videos.title: Battling Turned Up to Eleven!
videos.overview: As the Pokémon World Coronation Series continues, Ash looks to challenge a rising star from the Galar region — but gets wrong directions from Team Yell.

videos.title: Meeting Up with the Monarch!
videos.overview: While Goh goes to look for Pokémon in the Galar region, Ash ends up training with one of the world's greatest trainers, Leon.

videos.title: A One-Stick Wonder!
videos.overview: Traveling out to the Wild Area, Ash and Goh encounter a Thwackey with a problem: It only seems to have one stick when it needs two.

videos.title: Battling in the Freezing Raid!
videos.overview: As he takes on his latest Project Mew trial mission, Goh and a few allies challenge the legendary Pokémon Articuno to a raid battle.

videos.title: The Future Is Now, Thanks to Strategy!
videos.overview: To master a new attack, Sirfetch'd gets unexpected help from Dracovish. But will the move be enough for Ash to survive his upcoming battles?

videos.title: Taking Two for the Team!
videos.overview: In a battle against Drasna, Ash realizes a strong bond between Pokémon is the most important skill of all.

videos.title: Reuniting for the First Time!
videos.overview: While on a visit to Lilycove City to meet a Sylveon, Chloe gets recognized by Lisia, who encourages her to compete in a Pokémon Contest.

videos.title: Radio Lulled the Mischievous Stars!
videos.overview: To drum up more support for Team Rocket, Jessie and James take over a radio broadcast and win over some unexpected fans.

videos.title: Big Brother to the Rescue!
videos.overview: When the Pokémon in Cerise Park get out of sorts, it's up to a helpful Yamper to set things right again.

videos.title: Catching the Aura of Fate!
videos.overview: Hoping to help his Lucario grow stronger, Ash heads to the Kalos region to reconnect with Greninja, who teaches its protégé a thing or two.

videos.title: Aim for the Eight!
videos.overview: Ash must survive an entrance battle with a popular trainer to earn a spot in the top eight. But in the arena, all eyes are on the underdog from Kanto.

videos.title: Narrowing the Chaser Chase!
videos.overview: On his next trial mission for Project Mew, Goh must win a survival contest in Sea Mauville or he won't qualify as one of the chosen three Chasers.

videos.title: The Homecoming Crown!
videos.overview: In a frozen land, Ash, Goh and Chloe search for a rare Pokémon while Lillie and her family hope to reunite with their missing father.

videos.title: Helping the Hometown Hero!
videos.overview: Back in the Alola region, Ash joins a Battle Royal with three other trainers. But when any team can attack any Pokémon, who will survive?

videos.title: Chasing to the Finish!
videos.overview: Goh competes in his final trial mission for Project Mew: capturing a Regieleki and Regidrago. Will he receive enough tokens to earn the title of Chaser?

videos.title: Friends, Rivals, Lend Me Your Spirit!
videos.overview: To prepare for the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash reunites with his many Pokémon partners to battle an old rival and get as strong as possible.

videos.title: Curtain Up! Fight the Fights!
videos.overview: The Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament is underway! Ash arrives at Wyndon Stadium just in time for a battle between Leon and Alain.

videos.title: Pride of a Champion!
videos.overview: At the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash, Goh and their new friend Hop watch as Lance goes head to head with Diantha on the stage of dreams.

videos.title: The Fiery Road to Mastership!
videos.overview: Ash and his friends cheer on Cynthia and Iris in the third battle of the Masters Eight Tournament. With only one match left, will Ash's training pay off?

videos.title: Battling as Hard as Stone!
videos.overview: Ash battles Steven Stone in the Masters Eight Tournament. But can the Alola region champion prove he belongs on the same stage as the toughest trainers?

videos.title: Koharu and Eievui - The Miracle of Evolution
videos.overview: Barrierd has launched the so-called "Barri Channel" in order to shed light on the seven wonders of the Sakuragi Laboratories! What it's going to shed light on this time is Koharu's non-evolving Eievui?! Can it solve the mystery of this Eievui?! In addition, the radio show "You Are Swift Radio" is soliciting listeners to submit their problems?!

videos.title: Infinite Possibilities!
videos.overview: On a camping trip with her family, Chloe encounters friends from her father's past who help guide her in her decision whether or not to evolve Eevee.

videos.title: The Climax Begins! Satoshi's Masters Tournament Experience!!
videos.overview: The Pokémon World Championships semifinals are starting any minute now! But first, PWCS News will bring us an exclusive, thorough analysis of the Masters Tournament! They'll present all kinds of material ranging from analyses of the various competitors to confidential information on them! In addition, the radio show "A Dragon Dive Into Your Hearts" will present letters from its listeners!

videos.title: It's... Champion Time! (1)
videos.overview: On the morning of Leon and Diantha's battle, Ash and Cynthia run into two young fans who are full of questions about selecting Pokémon partners.

videos.title: Bewitch, Battle, and Bewilder! (2)
videos.overview: In the semifinals, the Sinnoh region champion Cynthia battles the very first Alola region champion Ash for the chance to take on the undefeated Leon.

videos.title: Valor: A Strategic Part of Battling! (3)
videos.overview: As the epic battle continues, underdog Ash struggles to keep up with champion Cynthia's aggressive strategy — but he won't go down without a fight.

videos.title: Whittle While You Work! (4)
videos.overview: The battle rages on, but Ash is down to his last Pokémon: Lucario. Can the power of their bond see them through to a victory over the Sinnoh champion?

videos.title: GO FOR DREAM! Go's Road to Mew!!
videos.overview: A suspicious shadow is sneaking up on Go's Smartphone Rotom in the hotel room he and Satoshi are staying at in Shoot City in the Galar region... We'll be shedding light on the info on Go's Pokémon and the top secret data on Project Mew contained within?! In addition, the radio show "A Blaze Kick After School" will be doing a special on childhood friends!!

videos.title: Just a Scone's Throw from Here!
videos.overview: On the eve of the finals, Ash and Goh enjoy a day off in town and run into a group of Nickit who've become popular for teaching other Pokémon to behave.

videos.title: Climax! The Night Before the Decisive Battle! Satoshi VS Dande!!
videos.overview: It's time for the Masters Tournament Finals, which will determine who's the best in the world, and PWCS News is doing a special that will present the finals the world is eagerly awaiting in greater detail than anywhere else! The special will provide a thorough coverage of not only highlights of Satoshi and Dande's battles, but also of the various encounters between the two! In addition, the special has obtained some exclusive news it's going to break?!

videos.title: A Flood of Torrential Gains! (1)
videos.overview: While Goh answers an emergency call from Project Mew, Ash heads into the finals of the Masters Eight Tournament, where Leon requests a full power battle.

videos.title: Toying with Your Motions! (2)
videos.overview: With each competitor down to their final five Pokémon, the battle wages. Ash fights to get an advantage over Leon, who effortlessly sets the pace.

videos.title: Paring Pokémon While Parrying! (3)
videos.overview: The fierce battle to determine who the strongest trainer is continues. Will Ash manage to see himself through to the ultimate victory?

videos.title: Partners in Time! (4)
videos.overview: The mysterious appearance of a legendary Eternatus above Wyndon Stadium grants Ash and Leon a bonus round, where it comes down to partner versus partner.

videos.title: The Mew from Here!
videos.overview: After picking up psychic energy signals, the Chasers set out to scale treacherous Table Mountain in search of Mew... but find surprises along the way.

videos.title: In the Palms of Our Hands!
videos.overview: On Faraway Island, the Chasers make a startling discovery and find themselves transported to a mysterious realm, where Goh connects with an old friend.

videos.title: Heroes Unite!
videos.overview: Goh has a new ambition to become a trainer worthy of partnering with Mew — but he's not sure how to broach the topic while camping with Ash and Chloe.

videos.title: This Could Be the Start of Something Big!
videos.overview: An epic battle with a legendary Pokémon reignites the fire in both Ash and Goh's hearts. But before they set out on new journeys, they must say goodbye.

videos.title: The Road Most Traveled!
videos.overview: While walking through the woods, Ash takes a random path that leads him to exciting encounters with many different types of Pokémon — and enemies.

videos.title: A Fated Face-Off!
videos.overview: Misty believes she's connected to a wild Clauncher by fate. Ash thinks his Corphish called dibs on it first. The only solution? A fishing battle!

videos.title: Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!
videos.overview: To cheer up a heartsick Brock, Ash and his friends take him to a nearby flower field, where he gets lost chasing after a tricky Psychic-type Pokémon.

videos.title: Bearing Down Easy!
videos.overview: On a snowy mountaintop, Ash and the team try to help a gloomy Beartic by encouraging it to regain control of its ice powers.

videos.title: A Squad's Worth of Passion!
videos.overview: Ash and friends decide to cheer on their old pal Squirtle at the Firefighting Squad Show, but the famous Pokémon's managers won't let the group say hi.

videos.title: The Same Moon, Now and Forever!
videos.overview: When Team Rocket causes Pikachu to get separated from the rest of his group, Ash relies on their strong connection to track down his best friend.

videos.title: Ride, Lapras, Ride!
videos.overview: A friendly Lapras takes Ash to a remote island, where a fellow Water-type needs the trainer's help. But Ash can't rescue the trapped Pokémon alone.

videos.title: Getting to the Heart of It All!
videos.overview: When a supernatural entity starts stealing heart-shaped objects from houses in a small town, Ash, Brock and Misty team up to solve the mystery.

videos.title: Rocket Revengers!
videos.overview: Team Rocket goes on a revenge mission to capture more Pokémon for their boss. The first step? Sending a Mime Jr. to gain Pikachu's trust.

videos.title: Ash and Latios!
videos.overview: Latias takes Ash on a journey to figure out what happened to Latios. But rescuing the legendary Pokémon becomes a bigger battle than they bargained for.

videos.title: The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!
videos.overview: As the group splits up, Ash and Pikachu return to Pallet Town, where they get some much-needed relaxation — before Team Rocket shows up.
